title: MojoBPF build evidence
description: Stable provenance for one finished build: input hashes per cache class, output hashes, applied transformations, license declarations, normalized commands and environment entries. Stable metadata excludes timestamps and absolute paths, so identical inputs serialize to identical bytes. Diagnostics stay in the build result and logs.

schema_version.description: Evidence schema version; this driver writes version 4 only.

artifact.description: Built artifact name from the manifest.

profile_id.description: Target profile identifier the build ran under.

success.description: Whether the build published; failed builds record inputs with empty outputs.

inputs.description: Cache-key input classes; every class participates in the key.

flags.description: Relevant build flag spellings; free of absolute paths.

profile_id.description: Target profile identifier the inputs were built under; cache keys invalidate across profiles.

profile_sha256.description: Digest of the resolved target profile implementation; cache keys invalidate across implementations.

adapter.description: Transform implementation identities, one '<file> <sha256>' per adapter file, sorted; never paths.

tool_version.description: mojobpf tool version; a tool upgrade invalidates the cache key.

sdk_version.description: Mojo SDK surface version ('major.minor'); an SDK upgrade invalidates the cache key.

outputs.description: Published objects with content hashes, mirroring the build result.

transforms.description: Applied transformations in order, attested by the pipeline caller.

license_mapping_version.description: Version of the declaration-pair mapping in force.

tool_version.description: mojobpf tool version that ran the build; the compatibility suites pin its exact value.

sdk_version.description: Mojo SDK surface version ('major.minor') that ran the build; additive-only within a major. The compatibility suites pin its exact value.

commands.description: Build commands with paths normalized to stable placeholders.

environment.description: Environment entries; all recorded values are hashes; secret-named entries are dropped.

hashed_file.description: One file: stable relative path plus content hash.
